extracted.name: Watermelon Lime Agua Fresca
extracted.description: This watermelon drink recipe combines fresh watermelon and lime juice to make a refreshing Mexican-style drink to serve over ice. Perfect for summer!
ingredient_lines: 5 cups peeled, cubed, and seeded watermelon
0.5 cup white sugar, or more to taste
0.33333334326744 cup lime juice, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine 1 cup water, watermelon, and sugar in a blender; process until smooth.
Pour mixture into a large pitcher; stir in lime juice and remaining 7 cups water. Taste; adjust sugar or lime juice. Refrigerate until chilled, about 1 hour.
